title: BIZRA URP Canonical Receipt v1.0
description: What every mission returns with after URP/SAT processing. This is the constitutional proof that a mission was governed. Equal law, variable execution: every node gets the same receipt structure regardless of hardware.

receipt_id.description: BLAKE3(envelope_id + sat_verdict + issued_at). The canonical proof hash.

envelope_id.description: Links back to the mission envelope that was submitted

issued_at.description: Unix timestamp when URP issued this receipt

sat_verdict.description: The SAT's constitutional judgment. This is where equal law lives.

outcome.description: accepted: local output meets floor. enriched: URP boosted quality. delegated: URP ran inference. degraded: partial result accepted. rejected: constitutional violation.

sat_agents_consulted.description: Which SAT agents participated in validation

enrichment_type.description: What the URP did to improve the output (null if accepted as-is)

enrichment_model.description: Model URP used for enrichment (informational, not prescriptive)

rejection_reason.description: Why the mission was rejected (null if not rejected)

final_state.description: Terminal mission state after URP processing

full_state_path.description: Complete state history: local states + URP states (e.g. [...local..., 'urp_validating', 'urp_enriching', 'complete'])

urp_adjusted_score.description: Score after URP enrichment (null if no enrichment)

floor_value.description: The Ihsan floor that was applied (0.85 minimum, 0.95 target)

degradation_audit.description: Complete degradation record. Must-never-fake rule enforced here.

impact_scoring.description: Proof-of-Impact assessment. Tokens are tied to verified impact, not hardware ownership.

impact_score.description: Composite impact score from SAT evaluation

seed_earned.description: SEED utility tokens earned by this mission

bloom_earned.description: BLOOM impact tokens earned (if mission contributed to network value)

contribution_class.description: What kind of value this mission added to the civilization

provenance_verified.description: Standing on Giants verification by SAT

knowledge_sources_verified.description: How many sources SAT could verify

network_eligible.description: Can this mission's results enter Tier 3 (network)? False for local_only or rejected missions.

persistence_instructions.description: What the local node must persist after receiving this receipt

persist_receipt.description: ALWAYS true. Every receipt must be persisted.

persist_response.description: Should the enriched response be stored locally?

promote_to_reflex.description: Should this successful pattern be fed to the reflex compiler?

extract_memory.description: Should memory fragments be extracted from this interaction?

urp_node_id.description: Identity of the URP node that processed this mission

urp_signature.description: Ed25519 signature by the URP node. Proves this receipt is authentic and was issued by a valid URP.

previous_receipt_hash.description: Hash of the previous receipt in this node's chain. Creates an append-only receipt ledger.
